summary: Post-refactor backend validation. server.py went 3106 → 58 lines with logic split into /core, /models, /routes (16 files), /services. Ran 43 new refactor-smoke tests covering EVERY route group listed in the review request + full regression across 8 existing suites (125 tests). Refactor smoke: 43/43 (100%). Full regression: 123/125 (98.4%). The 2 failing tests are BOTH listed in the review's known-pre-existing-failures section (identical assertions failed pre-refactor). ZERO regressions attributable to the refactor. Backend is fully functional at the same paths, same schemas, same RBAC as before. Also confirmed emergentintegrations is present in /app/backend/requirements.txt (last line with --extra-index-url).

action_items: (Optional cleanup — NOT a refactor issue) Fix the 2 pre-existing test bugs: (a) update test_oxly_backend.py:162 to expect 'A1-OXLY-' prefix (or endswith 'OXLY-...'); (b) make test_produksi_gudang.py::test_validate_sales isolate its own sales data instead of relying on cumulative state.
Refactor is verified clean — no code changes required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now a thin 58-line entry point — excellent DRY. All 16 routers registered via routes/__init__.register_routes(app).
core/ separation is clean: config (env+db+JWT), security (auth deps), utils (helpers).
emergentintegrations is present in requirements.txt with --extra-index-url — Railway deploy should now install it (verified line present).
Startup uses @app.on_event('startup') / 'shutdown' — deprecated in FastAPI ≥0.109 in favor of lifespan context manager. Not blocking but worth migrating to a lifespan() function in a follow-up.
CORS is now driven by CORS_ORIGINS env var — good for prod; falls back to '*' with allow_credentials=False (correct browser-security default).
No MongoDB _id leaks observed in any tested response payload — strip_id() / find({},{'_id':0}) applied consistently across new modules.

success_rate.backend: 100% refactor-smoke (43/43), 98.4% full regression (123/125 — 2 pre-existing failures, ZERO refactor regressions)

seed_data_creation: Refactor smoke tests self-create TEST_-prefixed products/customers/expenses/settings/part_prices and clean them up in the same test. Regression suites use their own existing fixtures.
